mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) exceeding 2% signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns during periods of FEDFUNDS < 0.5% are not significantly higher than in periods with FEDFUNDS > 1% (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) falls below 7%, signaling a tight labor market, S&P 500 forward returns tend to be positive over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative in > 60% of 5-day periods following UNRATE falling below 7%.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between increasing industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broadening economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for this interaction-driven signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in retail sales (RSAFS) exceeding $10 billion signals strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly correlated with RSAFS growth exceeding $10B (Pearson's r < 0.2).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 2%, signaling monetary tightening, S&P 500 forward returns tend to be negative over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 40% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between decreasing unemployment (UNRATE) and increasing payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: This interaction-driven signal's walk-forward IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained high level of industrial production (INDPRO > 95) indicates supply chain resilience, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during non-recessionary regimes.
failure_condition: SPX returns during non-recessionary periods with INDPRO > 95 are not significantly higher than in periods with INDPRO < 90 (t-test p > 0.05).
